retired.question: What are the names of the two original Disney Cruise Line ships that launched in the late 1990s?

retained.question: What is the name of Disney Cruise Line's first ship?

additionalComparisons.question: Which Disney Cruise Line ship entered service in 1999 as the sister ship to Disney Magic?

rationale: This pair aggregates the same original-ship identities as 136 (first ship Magic) and 961 (Wonder, the 1999 sister). Retain those more specific historical questions; 136 is the primary replacement pointer.

sources.evidence: The first DCL ships were Magic in July 1998 and Wonder in August 1999; Dream and Fantasy followed in 2011 and 2012.
sources.limitations: Primary institutional text inspected; no film or video viewing claimed.

sources.evidence: The six listed ships are Magic (1998), Wonder (1999), Dream (2011), Fantasy (2012), Wish (2022) and Treasure (maiden voyage December 21, 2024).
sources.limitations: Primary institutional text inspected; no film or video viewing claimed.

originalOptionAssessments.assessment: Magic and Wonder were the first pair, in 1998 and 1999.
Dream and Fantasy followed in 2011 and 2012.
Wish and Treasure entered service much later, in 2022 and 2024.
Magic fits but Dream does not belong to the 1990s pair.
